posts.cooked:
I need to fish Brian Mola's email address back out and give him editing access to the GDoc.

In the immediate term, the decks with yellow first columns have not been proofread by anybody. A second pass would be useful for any assorted other typos that have been missed or other issues. Beyond that, identifying the fonts used for any heroes not labeled would be good.

When Wrath starts arriving, it's going to be a matter of just plain typing them. My original is in Excel; a cloned GDoc would give people a place to work, too. If you go the latter route, sharing it with me would make splicing it into the master sheet more straightforward. My email address is my username here at comcast dot net.
